## The best person to develop a community is a young leader from within it.

The Community Friend Program is built on one powerful belief - sustainable community development happens from within, not from outside. We identify, train, and empower young leaders from rural communities - called Community Friends - who work at the grassroots level to drive meaningful, lasting change in their own neighbourhoods.

These are not outsiders arriving with solutions. These are local youth who understand local problems, speak the local language, and have the trust of their community. We give them the tools, training, and support to lead.

## What Community Friends do

- Identify local needs and map community challenges
- Mobilize youth for awareness programs and campaigns
- Organize community events, dialogues, and development activities
- Act as a bridge between Megh Foundation and the community
- Lead rural development initiatives from within
- Grow their own leadership, communication, and management skills

## Impact

Every Community Friend who grows becomes a multiplier - one trained youth leader can mobilize and impact dozens of families around them.
